plan.reader_block: A reader should feel the difference between looking at one unsupported picture and being able to see the relationship that a paragraph asks them to understand.
plan.source_relation: A conventional image prompt produces one image, while the Skill makes the reader's needed narrative relationship visible and keeps its support and placement connected.
plan.core_judgment: 不是多一张图，而是少一层理解负担
plan.subtitle: 孤立画面与关系可见的解释图，带来不同阅读结果
plan.visual_solution: Create two compact editorial vignettes that contrast the reader's experience, not product documents. Left: one seated reader in profile leans toward a small, attractive but isolated ink-picture tile; a tiny unresolved ink knot sits between the eye and the tile. Right: another seated reader leans toward a small hand-drawn explanatory vignette where one non-text source anchor dot, a thin relation line, and an article-margin insertion mark converge visibly. Make the right reader's open posture and settled gaze contrast with the left reader's uncertain tilted posture. Every figure is an intentional source-supported reader, never decoration; use shallow spatial cues only and no UI panels, dashboards, or card walls. Render no readable source prose or visible text beyond the declared title and subtitle.
must_show: The left reader faces one isolated image with no visible support or placement relation.
The right reader can visibly trace a non-text source anchor, a relationship mark, and an article-margin insertion into one explanatory vignette.
The two reader states and object connections remain distinct when the title is hidden.
must_not_imply: that the Skill invents facts beyond the source
that the illustration is a product UI or screenshot
any readable source prose or visible text beyond the declared title and subtitle
comparison_basis: The left alternative has an isolated image and an unresolved reader relation.
The right alternative visibly connects a non-text source anchor, a relationship mark, and an insertion point for the reader.

local_colours.target: the one relationship line in the right explanatory vignette
local_colours.rationale: show the source-supported connection that reduces reader inference

visible_evidence: One reader has only a lone image and a small unresolved knot.
The other reader sees a connected non-text source anchor, relation line, and article-margin insertion.
The reader postures and connection structures differentiate the two alternatives without labels.

continuity_rules: each reader has one complete connected head, torso, arms, and seated lower body
each reader interacts only with the nearby source-supported visual vignette
the right explanatory marks remain attached to one compact vignette
forbidden: impossible overlap between the two alternatives

plan.reader_block: A reader should see that source narrative, explanatory image, and article placement belong to one connected package rather than separate decorative outputs.
plan.source_relation: A readable Markdown narrative supplies a necessary explanatory image, and both belong to the delivered article package.
plan.core_judgment: 让叙事、解释图与文章落在同一套关系里
plan.subtitle: 不是附加装饰，而是相互连接的内容交付
plan.visual_solution: Depict one connected editorial hand and forearm holding a fine pencil inside a calm asymmetric system vignette. Around it, three unequal, source-supported elements form one open dependency structure: a tall loose narrative ribbon carrying only non-linguistic gray ink strokes, a compact explanatory image made of three connected abstract shapes, and an open article spread with one visual inset beside its paragraph rhythm. The pencil rests at the system's connection point, suggesting deliberate assembly without depicting a timeline. Use thin gray connectors and one tiny green connection point. Keep each paper form irregular and shallow, never a UI panel, dashboard, card wall, or text document. Render no visible text beyond the declared title and subtitle.
must_show: A non-linguistic narrative ribbon, explanatory image, and article spread appear as three connected components.
One hand-and-pencil action sits at their shared connection point.
The article spread visibly contains the explanatory image as an inset beside paragraph rhythm.
must_not_imply: that the Skill rewrites the source prose
that the output is only a decorative cover
that the workflow is a software interface
visible text beyond the declared title and subtitle
a required time sequence or feedback loop

local_colours.target: the single route from selected sentence through the explanatory image to the article anchor
local_colours.rationale: make the source-supported transformation and placement legible

visible_evidence: The narrative ribbon, explanatory image, and article spread are visibly distinct components.
Thin connectors visibly join the components at the hand-and-pencil connection point.
The article spread visibly includes the explanatory image as a placed inset.

continuity_rules: the visible hand and forearm belong to one connected person
the pencil is held by that same hand
the paper strip, explanatory image, and article spread remain separate objects connected only by the declared route

plan.reader_block: A reader should see that one relationship-to-visual capability serves writers, consultants, and facilitators in visibly different contexts.
plan.source_relation: One shared narrative relationship branches into an article package, a continuous presentation, and an explanatory training page for three distinct user groups.
plan.core_judgment: 同一套关系，进入三种真实工作现场
plan.subtitle: 写作、提案与培训各自得到不同的解释性画面
plan.visual_solution: Use one small upper shared relation knot—three uneven ink strokes meeting at one tiny green point—as the parent. Beneath it, three clearly subordinate editorial characters form an irregular shallow arc: left, a writer seated beside a long article sheet with one image inset; middle, a consultant standing in a lightly oblique posture while guiding a three-frame presentation sequence; right, a workshop facilitator leaning toward a simple loop drawn on a loose teaching sheet. Connect the upper knot to the three contexts with quiet thin gray parent-child lines, no arrowheads. Each person must have a distinct source-supported working posture and compact prop; do not use panels, card walls, fake software UI, or decorative bystanders.
must_show: One shared upper relation knot visibly connects downward to three subordinate real working contexts.
The writer, consultant, and facilitator each interact with a different source-supported output form: article inset, presentation sequence, and teaching explanation.
The non-directional connectors and upper parent preserve a hierarchy rather than a sequence.
must_not_imply: that the three contexts occur in time order
that the Skill creates editable PPTX files
that the figures represent specific real people or brands

local_colours.target: the one upper shared relation knot
local_colours.rationale: show the common source across all three user contexts

visible_evidence: A single upper relation knot connects to three lower figures.
Each lower figure has a distinct working posture and output form.
Thin non-directional connectors make the roles subordinate rather than sequential.

continuity_rules: each writer, consultant, and facilitator has one complete connected body with two attached arms
each person interacts with only their own compact source-supported prop
no limb overlaps another person in an impossible way
